title: II.12: Fugue in F minor

groocock.chapter: 7 Group 2: Fugues for Three Voices, without Stretto

entries.notes: tonal; in the dominant key from its beginning
only other use of answer form; extension 32-33
overlaps previous entry by one bar

episodes.material: development of bar 7: subject figures in middle, quasi-sequential quaver figure in soprano
repeated-note figure of bar 1 in thirds with suspensions; inversion of first figure of bar 3; bass develops quavers of bars 8-9 partly by diminution
basically a repeat of episode 2 with varied ending and upper voices interchanged (table: "episode 3, in v")
44-47 variant of ep.1; 47-50 bass repeats bar 47 twice lower (decorated falling scale) to a dominant pedal, upper voices in tenths

five sections: 54-55 imitation of figure from end of ep.4; 56-59 first subject figure in bass at various pitches with suspensions; 58-62 three-part imitation of bars 3-4 figures; 62-65 variant of 56-59; 66-71 repeat of ep.3

countersubjects.notes: soprano of bars 5-8 not a CS but provides material; its basic shape c-db-bb-c traceable in later accompaniments

subject.notes: first note is the dominant; answer starts on tonic and is in the dominant from its beginning; all other entries use subject form

key_plan: Group 2 table: Exp i v EP i | Dev EP III bVII EP i EP i EP iv | Final i

claims.claim: Exposition has an episode (bars 8-11) before the third entry.
Answer form occurs only once more (bar 28, pair III/bVII).
